counts.S: the head's slot: 189 + the number of chain layers - 1
counts.C: the catalog count: the number of task-packets/*.yaml
counts.P: the sum of K over every layer that binds PRODUCT_PACKETS
counts.relation: C = S + P; every later message and index doc says "C packets at slot S"

productId: the product YAML's file stem, equal to the YAML's id field and matching the verifier's PACKET_PATH form
matched with re.fullmatch, as PACKET_PATH (bundle-v4 verify_pr.py:81, verifier-ext verify_pr.py:68)
bindingRule: a module-level tuple of K >= 1 distinct product ids (productId)
bound only in a layer that publishes products; absent in every K = 0 layer
authorityRule: a mapping {id: sha256 of task-packets/<id>.yaml}, keys equal to PRODUCT_PACKETS
no key in baselinePackets or equal to NEW_PACKET; absent when K = 0
allowedPaths: a publishing meta packet lists exactly changedFiles | newFiles | {authority, validator, own YAML}

| {task-packets/

.yaml for p in PRODUCT_PACKETS}; the builder writes it, the head checks it by equality,
and the verifier's part 2 reads the product paths from it

reader: the verifier's line rule, packet_repository (bundle-v4 verify_pr.py:414-429, verifier-ext :401): exactly
one line starting with 'repository:', its value stripped, JSON-decoded when it starts with a double quote,
chainOnly: R12: the head also requires the value safe_load reads to equal the line's value; the verifier reads
only the line and adds no YAML library (Q-CPPD2-1 (a)); the v2 live identity test applies it, with
productId, the reader against allowedNames and refusedName, to every listed product (CPP-D3-2)

stepRule: a step whose new head binds PRODUCT_PACKETS (K >= 1) is explained by (i-p)-(v-p) and (ix-p)-(x-p)
a step whose new head binds no PRODUCT_PACKETS is explained by the identity rule's vocabulary, N per nReading
D, G1 and G2 take the product list as their one new parameter (the P-forms of section 4)

nReading.iii: N := S, so d = S - L

bumpVocabulary.i-p: an int constant C-1-K -> C (C the catalog count), only where (i) applies
bumpVocabulary.ii-p: a message constant in which every whole-word C-1-K becomes C (at least one)
iii-p: where (iii) applies, the display gains exactly two elements, appended last:
successor^d.NEW_PACKET, then *successor^d.PRODUCT_PACKETS, with d = S - L
bumpVocabulary.iv-p: slot 189 only: the set gains the meta id string, then the K product id strings in list order
v-p: at L = S - 2, where (v) applies, the tuple is (successor.NEW_PACKET, successor.successor.NEW_PACKET,

bridgeVocabulary.ix-p: after (ix), exactly one `if <x>.stem in successor.PRODUCT_PACKETS: continue`
bridgeVocabulary.x-p: the checkpoint phrases name the old head's catalog count C-1-K
